import json
from collections import Counter
p='answers.jsonl'
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open(p)]
rows[21]['errors']=[]
with open(p,'w') as f:
 for r in rows:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
assert len(rows)==len(cards)==56
assert [x['card_id'] for x in rows]==[x['card_id'] for x in cards]
assert len(set(x['card_id'] for x in rows))==len(rows)
fields={'card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'}
owner={'one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped'}
for r in rows:
 assert fields <= r.keys()
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and r['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert set(r['owner_crop'])==owner and all(x in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for x in r['owner_crop'].values())
 assert all(set(x)=={'label','printed'} for x in r['where'])
print('Count and order verified:',len(rows))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']: print(k,dict(Counter(r[k] for r in rows)))
print('Errors:',Counter(e for r in rows for e in r['errors']).most_common())
